notes: Complete migration of city research from the current legacy text files, including historical contradictions and batch context; not a fresh source verification. data/cities.json is authoritative for registered datasets. Null dates are unknown. Source references belong to their research record, not to every subject in a group. Importer matches establish exact code references only, not source usability, licensing or complete coverage.

actions.botanical_names_missing_or_codes: Inspect actual name values, coded-value domains, related tables and official botanical crosswalks; genus-only records can be usable.
actions.access_problem: Retry the recorded public service or find an official public export/view; do not bypass authentication.
actions.provenance_or_license_unclear: Establish publisher, municipal attribution, license and actual geography before importing.
actions.small_or_sparse_inventory: Recheck usable named-record counts and coverage; historical size cutoffs are not permanent acceptance rules.
actions.historical_inventory: Check survey dates and newer official inventories; do not infer freshness from a service title.
actions.wrong_geography_or_identity: Disambiguate municipality and inspect coordinates before associating an endpoint with a place.
actions.duplicate_or_overlap: Compare the registered importer and spatial coverage before adding an alternative or duplicate.
actions.limited_or_non_inventory_scope: Confirm this is a per-tree inventory and document coverage limits; search official municipal sources for broader coverage.
actions.data_quality_or_geometry: Inspect live attributes and coordinates; check existing importers for parsing, code-lookup and geometry workarounds.
actions.limited_search: Search official municipal GIS/open-data pages and non-ArcGIS download formats; the historical search was not exhaustive.
actions.coordination: Check the current registered importer rather than relying on the historical concurrent-agent claim.
actions.review_registered: Consult the registered importer and linked historical findings before further research; registration does not imply complete citywide coverage or acceptance of alternative sources.
actions.new_research: Revisit linked findings and official municipal sources; verify geography, public bulk access, botanical names, survey dates and usable coverage.
actions.import_details: Consult the linked importer for the implemented source and filtering/parsing behavior; recheck live data before revising historical counts or claims.
actions.disambiguate_group: Disambiguate subjects and split source-specific follow-up findings before applying any endpoint or verdict to an individual city.

research.text: Cities considered and rejected (reconstructed from research; earlier rejections from previous sessions were not recorded).

Indianapolis: no public inventory (only a 15-tree academic sample).
Nashville: canopy layers only.

Somerville, MA: only a Harvard-hosted March 2023 snapshot of unclear license.
Arlington County, VA: 30,842 trees, common names only.
Alexandria, VA: only a 275th-anniversary planting layer.
Montgomery County, MD: canopy rasters/polygons only.
Tacoma: canopy only.
